answer: Use peer-audited task bonds with one-seat cluster caps. 1) Each new key locks 46 POA for 28 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 46,000 POA, risks 23,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a comet crossing a glacier, each grove keeps one trackable root instead of cloned footprints.
